definitions.explanation: A common flying insect with two wings, often found around food and waste.

examples.english: When I opened the window, several flies came in, so I got rid of them with a fly swatter.

notes:
Also written as ハエ. Common species:
- イエバエ (housefly)
- キンバエ (blowfly)
- ショウジョウバエ (fruit fly)

Expressions:
- {蠅|はえ}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{殺|ころ}さぬ→殺す：01944_korosu⟧ (wouldn't hurt a fly - looks innocent)
- {蠅叩|はえたた}き (fly swatter)
- {蠅取|はえと}り{紙|がみ} (fly paper)

Associated with:
- Unsanitary conditions
- Summer nuisance
- Quick, erratic movement

Related vocabulary:
- ⟦ブンブン→ブンブン：05716_bunbun⟧ (buzzing sound)
- ⟦{虫除|むしよ}け→虫除け：09715_mushiyoke⟧ (insect repellent)
- ⟦{殺虫剤|さっちゅうざい}→殺虫剤：07036_sacchuuzai⟧ (insecticide)
- {蠅叩|はえたた}き (fly swatter)

The kanji {蠅|はえ} is complex; ハエ (katakana) is often used instead.
